title: Class 1 English Spelling Practice Test
description: This mock test is designed for Class 1 students to practice and improve their basic English spelling skills. It covers essential vocabulary, common words, and picture-based spelling identification to build a strong foundational language base.
instructions:
* This exam contains a total of 30 MCQ questions.
* Each correct answer carries 1 mark.
* There is no negative marking.
* Only one option is correct for each question.
* The timer will start as soon as the exam begins.
* Try to answer the maximum number of questions within the time limit.
* You can change your answers before the final submission.
* After submission, you can review the answer key with explanations.
* Your progress will be saved even if you refresh the page during the exam.
* Attempt honestly and use this test to evaluate your preparation.
examRules:
* No books or notes are allowed during the exam.
* Use of mobile phones or other devices is strictly prohibited.
* Select only one correct answer per question.
* The exam will be auto-submitted when the time runs out.
* You may retake this exam multiple times.
* Click the Submit button to view your results.
* Refresh the page if you face any technical issues.
* Avoid any form of dishonest practice during the exam.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for a domestic animal that says 'meow'.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the animal that meows is 'cat'.

optionExplanations.a: 'cta' is an incorrect letter arrangement for this animal.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'C-A-T' spells cat, a popular pet animal.
optionExplanations.c: 'act' is a verb or noun meaning action, not the animal.
optionExplanations.d: 'tca' is a completely meaningless letter sequence.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the animal that barks.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling for the barking pet is 'dog'.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'D-O-G' is the correct spelling for dog.
optionExplanations.b: 'dgo' has the letters placed in the wrong order.
optionExplanations.c: 'god' is a completely different word with spiritual meaning.
optionExplanations.d: 'ogd' is an invalid arrangement of letters.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling of the red fruit that keeps the doctor away.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the fruit apple contains double 'p'.

optionExplanations.a: 'paple' is misspelled with an extra 'p' at the beginning.
optionExplanations.b: 'aple' is missing one of the double 'p' letters.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'A-P-P-L-E' is the correct spelling of apple.
optionExplanations.d: 'aelpp' is a jumbled and incorrect spelling.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the yellow fruit that monkeys love to eat.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the fruit banana is b-a-n-a-n-a.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'B-A-N-A-N-A' is the correct spelling for banana.
optionExplanations.b: 'bannaa' has an incorrect ending arrangement.
optionExplanations.c: 'banaana' has extra vowels making it wrong.
optionExplanations.d: 'banna' is missing a syllable and letter.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the big animal with a trunk.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the large wild animal is 'elephant'.

optionExplanations.a: 'eliphant' uses an incorrect 'i' instead of 'e'.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'E-L-E-P-H-A-N-T' is the correct spelling of elephant.
optionExplanations.c: 'elefent' uses phonetic spelling with 'f' instead of 'ph'.
optionExplanations.d: 'elaphant' uses an incorrect 'a' in the middle.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the bird that can talk or mimic sounds.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the green bird with a red beak is 'parrot'.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'P-A-R-R-O-T' is the correct spelling for parrot.
optionExplanations.b: 'parot' is missing the second 'r'.
optionExplanations.c: 'parrat' has an incorrect ending vowel.
optionExplanations.d: 'perrot' uses an incorrect initial vowel 'e'.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the school building space where you study.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the place of learning is 'school'.

optionExplanations.a: 'scholl' contains an extra 'l'.
optionExplanations.b: 'shool' is missing the letter 'c'.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'S-C-H-O-O-L' is the standard spelling for school.
optionExplanations.d: 'skool' is an informal phonetic spelling, not standard.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the book used for drawing or writing notes.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of an item containing pages for reading or writing is 'book'.

optionExplanations.a: 'cota' is an incorrect combination of letters.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'B-O-O-K' is the correct spelling for book.
optionExplanations.c: 'boko' is an incorrect letter sequence.
optionExplanations.d: 'obok' is a scrambled arrangement.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling of the object used with ink or lead to write.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the writing tool is 'pencil'.

optionExplanations.a: 'pensil' uses an incorrect 's' instead of 'c'.
optionExplanations.b: 'pencel' uses an incorrect 'e' at the end.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'P-E-N-C-I-L' is the correct spelling for pencil.
optionExplanations.d: 'pancil' uses an incorrect vowel 'a'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the water body where fish live.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling for a flowing natural stream of water is 'river'.

optionExplanations.a: 'rver' is missing the middle vowel 'i'.
optionExplanations.b: 'rivar' uses an incorrect ending vowel 'a'.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'R-I-V-E-R' is the correct spelling for river.
optionExplanations.d: 'riwer' uses an incorrect consonant 'w'.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling of the bright celestial body that shines during the day.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the daytime star giving us light and heat is 'sun'.

optionExplanations.a: 'suun' has an extra vowel making it incorrect.
optionExplanations.b: 'sunn' has an unnecessary extra 'n'.
optionExplanations.c: 'sune' is misspelled with a silent 'e'.
optionExplanations.d: Correct! 'S-U-N' is the correct spelling for sun.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the natural satellite that shines at night.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the night sky glowing orb is 'moon'.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'M-O-O-N' is the correct spelling for moon.
optionExplanations.b: 'monn' has only one 'o' and double 'n', which is wrong.
optionExplanations.c: 'moun' uses an incorrect vowel combination 'ou'.
optionExplanations.d: 'mune' is an incorrect phonetic spelling.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the colorful object that flies in the sky with a string.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the flying toy is 'kite'.

optionExplanations.a: 'kiet' has letters reversed in the middle.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'K-I-T-E' is the correct spelling for kite.
optionExplanations.c: 'keit' uses an incorrect vowel digraph 'ei'.
optionExplanations.d: 'kyti' uses incorrect consonants and vowels.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the animal known as the king of the jungle.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the wild roaring cat is 'lion'.

optionExplanations.a: 'lien' is a legal term, not the animal.
optionExplanations.b: 'line' is a geometric stroke, not the animal.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'L-I-O-N' is the correct spelling for lion.
optionExplanations.d: 'loin' is a cut of meat, not the animal.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling of the tall plant with trunk, branches, and green leaves.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the woody perennial plant is 'tree'.

optionExplanations.a: 'tre' is missing one of the double 'e' letters.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'T-R-E-E' is the correct spelling for tree.
optionExplanations.c: 'tere' has letters mixed up incorrectly.
optionExplanations.d: 'teer' is an incorrect arrangement of letters.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the structure where people live with their families.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of a human dwelling building is 'house'.

optionExplanations.a: 'huose' has the 'o' and 'u' swapped.
optionExplanations.b: 'houes' has the 's' and 'e' swapped at the end.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'H-O-U-S-E' is the correct spelling for house.
optionExplanations.d: 'suhoe' is a completely jumbled word.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the bird that can swim in water and quacks.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the swimming water bird is 'duck'.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'D-U-C-K' is the correct spelling for duck.
optionExplanations.b: 'duk' is missing the letter 'c'.
optionExplanations.c: 'dcuk' has letters out of standard order.
optionExplanations.d: 'udck' is an incorrect spelling arrangement.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the small crawling insect that loves sweet things like sugar.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the tiny social insect is 'ant'.

optionExplanations.a: 'antt' has an extra 't' at the end.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'A-N-T' is the correct spelling for ant.
optionExplanations.c: 'nat' is a nickname or incorrect spelling for this insect.
optionExplanations.d: 'atn' is a jumbled letter sequence.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the farm animal that gives us milk.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the milk-giving farm animal is 'cow'.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'C-O-W' is the correct spelling for cow.
optionExplanations.b: 'cwo' has the letters out of order.
optionExplanations.c: 'woc' is an incorrect backward sequence.
optionExplanations.d: 'ocw' is an invalid spelling.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the farm animal that eats grass and has wool.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the wool-bearing animal is 'sheep'.

optionExplanations.a: 'sheap' uses an incorrect vowel combination 'ea'.
optionExplanations.b: 'shiep' uses an incorrect vowel combination 'ie'.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'S-H-E-E-P' is the correct spelling for sheep.
optionExplanations.d: 'sehep' has letters arranged incorrectly.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the bird with beautiful colorful feathers that dances when it rains.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of our national bird is 'peacock'.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'P-E-A-C-O-C-K' is the correct spelling for peacock.
optionExplanations.b: 'pecock' is missing the letter 'a'.
optionExplanations.c: 'peacok' is missing the final 'k'.
optionExplanations.d: 'picock' uses an incorrect vowel 'i' at the start.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the vehicle with four wheels that runs on roads.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of a motor vehicle used for traveling is 'car'.

optionExplanations.a: 'kar' uses a phonetic 'k' instead of standard 'c'.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'C-A-R' is the correct spelling for car.
optionExplanations.c: 'cra' has letters in the wrong order.
optionExplanations.d: 'arc' is a curved geometric shape, not the vehicle.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the transport that runs on iron tracks.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the railway vehicle is 'train'.

optionExplanations.a: 'trane' includes a silent 'e' making it incorrect.
optionExplanations.b: 'trian' has an incorrect vowel placement.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'T-R-A-I-N' is the correct spelling for train.
optionExplanations.d: 'trani' uses an incorrect ending vowel 'i'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the round object used in games like football or cricket.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of a spherical playing object is 'ball'.

optionExplanations.a: 'bal' is missing the second 'l'.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'B-A-L-L' is the correct spelling for ball.
optionExplanations.c: 'lbla' is a meaningless jumbled arrangement.
optionExplanations.d: 'lalb' is an incorrect letter combination.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the sweet dairy product used in tea or drunk directly.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the white nutritious liquid food is 'milk'.

optionExplanations.a: 'milck' contains an unnecessary 'c'.
optionExplanations.b: 'mielk' has incorrect vowel placement.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'M-I-L-K' is the correct spelling for milk.
optionExplanations.d: 'mlik' has the letters 'l' and 'i' swapped.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the morning meal eaten before going to school.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the first meal of the day is 'breakfast'.

optionExplanations.a: 'breakfrast' contains an incorrect extra 'r'.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'B-R-E-A-K-F-A-S-T' is the correct spelling for breakfast.
optionExplanations.c: 'brakfast' is missing the letter 'e' in the first syllable.
optionExplanations.d: 'brekfast' is missing the letter 'a' in the first part.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the body part with five fingers used for holding things.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the upper limb extremity is 'hand'.

optionExplanations.a: Correct! 'H-A-N-D' is the correct spelling for hand.
optionExplanations.b: 'hadn' has the 'n' and 'd' swapped.
optionExplanations.c: 'hnad' has letters out of order.
optionExplanations.d: 'dhna' is a completely jumbled word.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the body part used for walking and running.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the lower limb base part is 'foot'.

optionExplanations.a: 'fote' uses an incorrect silent 'e'.
optionExplanations.b: Correct! 'F-O-O-T' is the correct spelling for foot.
optionExplanations.c: 'futo' is an incorrect phonetic spelling.
optionExplanations.d: 'toof' is a backward arrangement of letters.

questions.questionText: Select the correct spelling for the colorful bow seen in the sky after rain.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the meteorological arched color spectrum is 'rainbow'.

optionExplanations.a: 'rainbou' uses an incorrect ending 'ou'.
optionExplanations.b: 'rainbo' is missing the final letter 'w'.
optionExplanations.c: Correct! 'R-A-I-N-B-O-W' is the correct spelling for rainbow.
optionExplanations.d: 'renbow' uses an incorrect vowel 'e' at the start.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct spelling for the bright twinkling bodies seen in the night sky.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling of the luminous astronomical body shining at night is 'star'.

optionExplanations.a: 'starre' uses archaic or incorrect extra letters.
optionExplanations.b: 'stare' means to look fixedly, not the celestial object.
optionExplanations.c: 'sart' has the letters out of sequence.
optionExplanations.d: Correct! 'S-T-A-R' is the correct spelling for star.
